notes.title: EX Pack: Beta 1.7
notes.notes:
Beta 1.7 is available for anyone with the EX pack. This should tone down Boss Rush mode a bit. 

Please share your opinions!

notes.title: Version 1.5
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, 

Due to recent scores obtained with the help of a keyboard macro, we have updated Mobile Astro to curb this sort of activity. 

[b]If you want to submit scores to the leaderboards, you must install this update.[/b]

-The Management

notes.title: Update Recap
notes.notes:
Hey, everybody! Considering the importance of the two most recent updates, we thought we'd recap everything in this single post. 

In addition to the initial Arcade and Survival modes, Mobile Astro now has
[list]
[*]Arcade EX Mode: Eight new stages, four boss battles, and a different flow.
[*]Boss Rush Mode: Eliminate all of the bosses as quickly as possible. 
[*]Trading Cards: We know many of you like this kind of stuff. 
[*]Achievements: Show everyone how skilled you are.
[/list]
Not bad, right? 

If there's anything else you'd like to see, we would love to hear it. After all, player input is what gave us the push to release all of this new stuff.

We hope you continue to enjoy Mobile Astro!

notes.title: Version 1.3: Achievements have arrived!
notes.notes:
Hey there!

After receiving several requests, we have added achievements to Mobile Astro.

Three of these can be unlocked by completing Arcade mode, Arcade EX mode, and Boss Rush mode. The other one is obtained by reaching wave 20 in Survival mode. 

Additionally, we fixed a few very minor bugs. 

We hope this makes Mobile Astro that much more enjoyable. Have fun!

notes.title: New modes, new stages, new challenges! Version 1.2 has arrived!
notes.notes:
Hey there! We hope all of you have been enjoying Mobile Astro so far!

Here's what's new in version 1.2:

[b]Arcade EX Mode[/b]
[list]
[*]Eight stages.
[*]Four boss battles.
[*]New dynamic with a slightly different difficulty curve. 
[/list]
[b]Boss Rush Mode[/b]
[list]
[*]Take on all eight bosses consecutively.
[*]Compete for the fastest completion time. 
[/list]
[b]Trading cards have been released alongside this update.[/b]

[b]The Korean localization is now available. Give [i]dollppin[/i] some love for his amazing effort![/b]

We hope you enjoy these new additions to the game!

notes.title: Upcoming Content
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone!

On [b]February 11th[/b], we'll be adding new Mobile Astro content via an update. The new in-game content isn't going to cost you a thing! With that said, here's what you can expect from the update:

[b]Arcade EX Mode[/b]
[list]
[*]Eight new stages.
[*]Four boss battles.
[*]New dynamic with a slightly different difficulty curve. 
[/list]
[b]Boss Rush Mode[/b]
[list]
[*]Take on all eight bosses consecutively.
[*]Compete for the fastest completion time. 
[/list]
[b]Trading Cards[/b]
[list]
[*]Because why not?
[/list]
[b]Korean translation courtesy of [i]dollppin[/i].

Assorted bug fixes.[/b]

We hope you look forward to all of this new stuff. Thanks for sticking with us, and thanks for playing Mobile Astro!

notes.title: Version 1.01 is here!
notes.notes:
We hope everyone enjoyed the holidays!

Here's what's new in version 1.01:
[list]
[*]Stuttering and performance problems on Windows 10 have been fixed.
[*]Powerup sprites have been updated to stand out more. 
[*]Powerups will no longer be outside of the player's horizontal boundaries. 
[/list]

These changes also apply to the demo version. 

Hopefully, this buttons down any issues that some of you were having. If you encounter any problems, or have any suggestions, we're here for you!
